text:
anya: heads up — starting bring-up for rnk3b-mini (3B) quantized staging build. quick smoke: int8 + kvpack. initial eval shows ndcg down ~6% vs fp16 baseline. pasting quick output.

sam: can you paste the exact eval command?

anya: sure:
```
./rune_eval --model rnk3b-mini:int8 --holdout core_holdout.jsonl --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --batch 64 --seed 42
```

anya: eval snippet:
```
Baseline fp16: ndcg@10=0.312, mrr=0.421
rnk3b-mini:int8: ndcg@10=0.293 (-6.1%), mrr=0.418 (-0.7%)
```

mike: odd that MRR is fine but NDCG drops more. could be tokenization, truncation, or a preprocessing mismatch.

rachel: did the int8 image pick up a different tokenizer or preproc? those have bit-rotten us before.

anya: good catch — staging int8 used tokenizer v2, while our fp16 baseline used tokenizer v1. default flipped in the container by accident.

sam: re-run forcing tokenizer v1 to check parity.

anya: re-running now with `--tokenizer v1`. ci-bot: deploy-staging rnk3b-mini:int8 started (build 1234).

anya: run done. results:
```
rnk3b-mini:int8 (tokenizer v1): ndcg@10=0.305 (-2.2%), mrr=0.420 (-0.2%)
```

sam: much better. tokenizer mismatch explains majority of the loss.

mike: still a residual ndcg gap. i want cross-slice checks (longtail_holdout, core_holdout, random_holdout) to see where regression concentrates.

anya: queued longtail + combined slices. also noticed int8 preproc path left raw HTML in some docs (we have two bringup preproc branches). that could affect ranking signals.

rachel: yep html tags + different strip rules will change doc text. we need exact parity on normalization.

mike: let's add two small smoke checks to onboarding: (1) token id parity on 100 sampled queries, (2) stripped_text hash parity for 100 sample docs.

anya: PR #2896 created to add those smoke tests. assigning to rachel and sam.

sam: include eval command, seed, and artifacts in the upload so runs are reproducible.

anya: uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/onboard/rnk3b-mini/1714008888/ (meta.json, eval.log, sample-token-comparisons.jsonl).

mike: next test: rerun quant calibration with kvpack disabled to check interaction between packing and quant noise.

anya: running kvpack-off now.

ci-bot: build 1234 kvpack-off run started.

anya: kvpack-off finished:
```
rnk3b-mini:int8 (tokenizer v1, kvpack off): ndcg@10=0.307 (-1.6%), mrr=0.420 (-0.2%)
```

mike: kvpack adds a small delta but tokenizer mismatch was dominant. good to know.

rachel: i'll merge the PR after a quick docs note. we should also pin tokenizer version in bringup.md to avoid regressions.

anya: added docs note and linked PR in the artifacts.

sam: one more ask: can we produce per-query ndcg deltas and upload the top 50 regressors to help SRE/product repro issues?

anya: adding per_query_deltas.csv to artifacts.

mike: outcome: no rollback. add parity smoke tests to CI gate; update onboarding checklist and docs. closing the loop.

anya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
